physics_conclusion: After a0=0 exact cancellation (verifier #70), the only non-topological curvature-squared term in a4 is Weyl², which is conformally invariant in d=4. Under RG flow, the trace/conformal anomaly generates an effective CC ONLY after conformal symmetry is broken by the Higgs vev v=246 GeV; the induced scale is v^4/(16π²) ~ 10^8 GeV^4 (Coleman-Weinberg), NOT M_P^4 ~ 10^76 GeV^4 (a factor 10^68 improvement in fine-tuning). The residual mismatch (~10^56 between Coleman-Weinberg scale and observed ρ_Λ ~ 10^-47 GeV^4) is the genuine cosmological constant problem (Weinberg 1989), addressable by anthropic/landscape reasoning within plenitude or further IR conformal dynamics; it is NOT a problem of UV cutoff sensitivity. The a-theorem holds: a_UV > a_IR (monotonic flow). In the unbroken conformal phase (v=0) the CC is exactly zero. The Weyl² coupling runs logarithmically (not power-law).
